_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
O motshameki {player_id} mo motshamekong wa Liar's Dice wa batsamaisi ba {num_players}.
Melao:
- Fa o le mo tshamekong ya gago, o ka:
  1) Dirisa bid e ntšha ka palo e kgolo gape gape kgolo (kgotsa zombili) go feta bid e e teng; e.g. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Bidisa bid ya bofelo ka go keteka '[Call]'.

Fa o bidisa:
  - Fa palo ya nnete ya maadima a matlhopho a tsebe go ralala matlhopho yotlhe e le kwa tlase ga bid, motshameki wa bofelo o latlhega tsebe.
  - Gape, motshameki yo o bidisitseng o latlhega tsebe.
Motshameki yo o fitlheletseng 0 matlhopho a tsebe o latlhegelwa. Motshameki wa bofelo yo o setseng o fentse.

board.new_round:
Mafelo a mantsi - Diketo di seng dikgweleditse: {dice_summary}
Diketo tsa gago tse di mo gae kwa: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Motshameki {current_player_id} o bidisa! Palo ya nnete ya maadima a matlhopho a tsebe {face_value} ke {count}, e e le kwa tlase ga {quantity}.
Motshameki {loser_id} (motshameki wa bofelo) o latlhega tsebe.
call.caller_loses:
Motshameki {current_player_id} o bitsa! Palo ya sesupo {face_value} ke {count}, e e fetang kana e lekana le {quantity}.
Motshameki {loser_id} (yoo bitsang) o latlhegelwa ke tsebe nngwe.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: O ne a dira jalo kwantle ga go ntsha moneelo pele.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Tshwanelo ya tiro e seng ya itsiwe e le '[Bid: X, Y]' kgotsa '[Call]'. Tiro e e filweng: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Palo e ntšha {new_quantity} ke kwa tlase ga ya jaanong {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Boleng jo boša jwa leina {new_face_value} ke kwa tlase ga boleng jwa jaanong jwa leina la {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Thekiso e tshwana le theki ya ga jaana.
bid_reason.face_range: Boleng jwa yone bo tshwanetse go nna fa gare ga 1 le 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a tswa ka motsamao wa gagwe e le o sa tshwanelang.

outcome.win: Motshameki {winner} o fentse! Lenane la batsamaisi: {final_ranking}
